module: Auxiliary drag (acceleration) timing controller. State machine ready, countdown, measuring, done: when the transbrake is active and the throttle pressed, a 3 s countdown starts; at the end, it releases the transbrake (controller named "transbrake") and measures the times at 60 feet (18.288 m), 1/8 mile (201.168 m) and 1/4 mile (402.336 m) as well as the speeds at these last two marks, then displays the results in the console (in mph). Order tied to the `gearbox` device.
notes: Uses `electrics.values.transbrake` and `electrics.values.throttle`. Releasing during the countdown (throttle released or transbrake cut) goes back to `ready`.
Depends on the existence of a controller named exactly "transbrake": `controller.getController("transbrake").setTransbrake(false)` is called without a test (error if it does not exist).
Measurement stops after 25 s even without having reached the quarter mile. The results are only printed (print) and a UI message "Results are in!" is displayed; they are not stored in electrics.
No `reset` function: controller.reset calls init again (ready state).

relevantDevice.desc: "gearbox": powertrain device used for the call order.

updateGFX.desc: Empty (the work is done in update).

update.desc: Physics step: advances the state machine (arming, countdown, measurement, results display).

init.desc: Puts the state machine back to ready and all times to 0.
